title: Mortgage With a Seasonal Job in Myrtle Beach: How It Works
description: Can you get a mortgage with a seasonal job on the Grand Strand? What lenders need, how winter unemployment can count, and options for seasonal businesses.
h1: Can You Get a Mortgage With a Seasonal Job? A Grand Strand Guide
dek: Work the season in Myrtle Beach? Here's how lenders count your income, including winter unemployment.

faq.q: Can you get a mortgage with a seasonal job?
faq.a: Yes. Lenders can count seasonal income when you have at least a two-year history of it. They average your income from this year and the previous two years.

faq.q: Does unemployment count as income for a mortgage?
faq.a: Seasonal unemployment can count when it clearly comes from a seasonal layoff, is expected to recur, has been received for at least two years, and shows on your tax returns.

faq.q: How do lenders calculate seasonal income?
faq.a: Under Fannie Mae's rule, the lender averages your year-to-date income with the previous two years of earnings, using your pay stub and W-2s or a verification from your employer.

faq.q: I own a seasonal business. What loan works?
faq.a: A bank statement loan can use 12 to 24 months of business or personal deposits instead of tax returns, which captures both busy and slow months.
